context: Tests SKILL.md B.9's branch selection: when scopeChoice is local-no-login, the agent must uncomment the DISABLE_AUTHENTICATION block in cloudflare/src/auth.js, explain the fake-admin implication, and set customer.authBypassActive to true — and must NOT walk the customer through an Entra app registration, which belongs only to the local-login branch. Guards a security-relevant branch-selection bug.

checklist.name: Bypass block uncommented
checklist.description: The DISABLE_AUTHENTICATION block in cloudflare/src/auth.js is uncommented (active code, not a // comment) after the agent's edit, and no unrelated code in the file is altered.

checklist.name: authBypassActive set to true
checklist.description: The state file's customer.authBypassActive is true after this turn.

checklist.name: No Entra walkthrough in this branch
checklist.description: The agent does not walk the customer through a Microsoft Entra app registration, tenant ID, or client ID/secret setup — that belongs only to the local-login branch, not local-no-login.

checklist.name: States the fake-admin implication and revert requirement
checklist.description: The agent tells the customer this makes every local visitor a fake local-admin user, that it's fine only for local dev, and that it must be re-commented before deploy.

checklist.name: No re-ask of tier choice
checklist.description: The agent does not ask the customer to choose a run tier again — it proceeds on the already-recorded local-no-login choice.
